changelog.notes: Reference instrument for the test bench. beta and the OH flux factor are computed by swift_comet_pipeline 0.3; the values here are for reference only.

beta.source: swift_comet_pipeline beta_parameter(0 %/100 nm, uw1, uvv); recomputed at run time

oh_flux_per_count_rate.unit: erg cm-2 s-1 per ct s-1
oh_flux_per_count_rate.source: swift_comet_pipeline flux_OH (Bodewits et al. 2019 OH spectrum through UVW1)
